sourceScenario.title: Assigned task completion, salary accrual and exact coffee debit

steps.description: Read authoritative initial character creation state
A new isolated test profile starts at character creation

steps.name: creation-industry
steps.description: Capture the first creation step
Choose internet industry
Allow the industry selection and any dismissed event transition to settle
Click the visible next-step button and wait for the authoritative direction state
Confirm the second creation step
Choose the available technical direction
Advance to profession and verify the authoritative wizard state
Choose Java backend profession
Advance to identity and verify the authoritative wizard state
Enter a test nickname with real keyboard input
Scroll the identity form until its save control is inside the clipped panel
Verify the identity save control is now visible and uncovered
Save identity through the creation UI
Wait for the identity form save to settle before changing the scroll region
Scroll to the background choices after saving identity
Choose a valid starting background
Wait until the real character-creation UI reflects the selected background
Confirm the chosen background is the authoritative wizard state before advancing

steps.name: creation-identity-backgrounds
steps.description: Verify the background choice through its selected UI state
Advance to destiny and verify the authoritative wizard state
Scroll the tall destiny candidate cards into the visible area
Choose a destiny candidate
Allow the selected destiny to settle before advancing
Advance to allocation and verify the authoritative wizard state
Keep the valid default allocation and verify the confirmation state
Finalize the character through the UI
Enter the game through the real onboarding control and verify its authoritative state, retrying only while still at the first story step
The onboarding action completed before dependent first-task checks
Onboarding creates its first real assigned task
The home page has an open assigned task
Complete the assigned task through the canonical task service
Task completion credits the existing salary wallet
Task completion advances a daily home goal
Align the canonical game clock to the start of its work window
Advance thirty work minutes so even a 0.9 destiny multiplier yields a whole wage unit under the existing integer settlement rules
Work time increases the canonical wage balance
The authoritative work-time counter advances
If real daily settlement opened during the scenario, close it through its 明天见 button and verify removal
If a critical-message popup interrupts, choose its real conversation option and verify the popup is gone
Return to the home page after handling any critical message
Confirm the home page is restored before checking wages and assigned tasks
Read the existing authoritative price and daily-limit table
The authoritative coffee price is ¥18
Resolve a late critical-message interrupt by choosing its real conversation, then verify the popup is gone
Return to home after any critical-message choice before the coffee interaction
Confirm the home page is restored before scrolling to coffee
Scroll the home column before checking for a newly appearing interruption
Resolve a critical-message interruption that appeared while scrolling, then verify its real conversation choice closed the modal
Restore the home page after any critical-message conversation selection during scrolling
Re-scroll after modal recovery redraws home and resets its scroll position
Verify the home column is visible immediately before the coffee transaction
Confirm the coffee purchase control is visible, in bounds and uncovered
Buy coffee with a real CDP click on the home UI
Coffee debits exactly ¥18 from the canonical wallet
Milk tea price is verified from the same service definition
Lunch price is verified from the same service definition
Snack daily limit is verified from the same service definition
Dinner price is verified from the same service definition
